title: Admin search synonyms
summary: Admin search finds more pages and plugins from everyday words and the new workflow labels.
changes: Admin search synonyms cover words such as reactivate, employees, group mappings, code not shipped, mail log and maintenance mode.
Plugin search synonyms include workflow labels such as waiting on user, urgent, under review, neutering and check-up.
Search synonyms stay in lang files only; there is no Language editor.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: search synonym additions only.
validation: AdminSearchKeywordsTest covers the new synonyms and keyword list hygiene.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
